description: Stable accident identifier at expediente level.
traceability_rule: Must come from accident_master and remain unchanged through matching.

description: Projected x coordinate in EPSG:25830.
traceability_rule: Distance calculations are only valid if CRS stays explicit.

description: Projected y coordinate in EPSG:25830.
traceability_rule: Distance calculations are only valid if CRS stays explicit.

description: Coordinate reference system of the accident point.
traceability_rule: Must equal the canonical network CRS before matching.

description: Accident date for later historical aggregation windows.
traceability_rule: Should stay at accident level, not raw row level.

description: Accident time for future temporal bucketing.
traceability_rule: Should remain attached to the matched edge record.

description: Accident type retained for downstream descriptive summaries.
traceability_rule: Not required to compute distance, but useful in later aggregation.

description: Stable canonical edge identifier.
traceability_rule: Primary edge key; never substitute with sensor or tramo ids.

description: Origin node of the edge geometry orientation.
traceability_rule: Must exist in the canonical nodes table.

description: Destination node of the edge geometry orientation.
traceability_rule: Must exist in the canonical nodes table.

description: Edge length in meters in the canonical CRS.
traceability_rule: Should be recomputable from geometry if needed.

description: Canonical edge geometry in EPSG:25830.
traceability_rule: Distance to accident is always traced against this geometry.

description: Original OSM feature id behind the canonical segment.
traceability_rule: Preserves provenance after segmentation.

description: Geofabrik road class retained for filtering and later routing logic.
traceability_rule: Auxiliary context; not a substitute for edge_id.

description: Binary match status: matched / unmatched.
traceability_rule: Ambiguity does not create a third status; it is reflected through quality_flag and tie diagnostics.

description: Chosen canonical edge for the accident.
traceability_rule: Primary matched-edge field; must reference canonical edge_id, never tramo or sensor ids.

description: Number of candidate edges evaluated inside the search radius.
traceability_rule: Useful to detect ambiguous local geometry.

description: Radius used to look for candidate edges around the accident point.
traceability_rule: Must be stored to reproduce the matching decision.

description: Shortest point-to-line distance from accident to matched edge.
traceability_rule: Primary geometric traceability metric.

description: Distance along the matched edge from the projected point to the start node.
traceability_rule: Useful to inspect projection position along the edge.

description: Distance along the matched edge from the projected point to the end node.
traceability_rule: Useful to inspect projection position along the edge.

description: Relative position of the projected point along the edge geometry.
traceability_rule: Useful to reproduce where along the edge the accident fell.

description: Projected point geometry stored as WKT in the CSV output.
traceability_rule: Supports spatial QA of the matching output; the GeoJSON also stores the projected geometry as real geometry.

description: Method identifier used in M9, e.g. nearest_edge_projected.
traceability_rule: Needed for auditability if the matching logic changes later.

description: Match quality label: high_confidence / medium_confidence / low_confidence / unmatched.
traceability_rule: Ambiguity is reflected here, not in match_status.

description: Number of candidates within the tie tolerance of the minimum distance.
traceability_rule: Useful to trace ambiguous local geometry around the selected edge.

description: Deterministic rule used to choose the final edge among candidates.
traceability_rule: Documents whether the match was resolved by min distance only or by tie-breaking.

description: Top candidate edge ids ordered by selection priority.
traceability_rule: Compact audit trail for near alternatives.

description: Top candidate distances in meters ordered by selection priority.
traceability_rule: Compact audit trail for near alternatives.

description: Reason for unmatched status.
traceability_rule: Makes invalid coordinates, outside envelope and no-candidate cases explicit.

description: Whether the accident lies outside the canonical network operational envelope.
traceability_rule: Supports explicit reporting of envelope coverage.

description: Nearest canonical edge even when the accident remains unmatched.
traceability_rule: Diagnostic only; never treated as a successful match.

description: Distance to the nearest canonical edge for unmatched cases.
traceability_rule: Diagnostic only; useful to inspect misses near the envelope or search radius.
